svg.text: Component architecture | Multimodal RAG + commerce analytics + grounded campaign generation
Chat + campaign studio → Product / market / channel / objective → Protected Cloud Run API
• Source event starts a durable job
• Typed queries for store / SKU metrics
• Read real images; retain query IDs
• Pin all model / prompt / policy versions
Vertex AI + Google Gen AI SDK
• Compose scene, copy and real product
• Save image bytes + exact render manifest
• Reviewer decision tied to exact artifact
Typed inputs / outputs • Exact prompt + source binding • One provider attempt per durable slot • Budgeted timeouts • Recovery before retry
• Least privilege per worker and table
• No repeated call after lost response
• Product catalog / PIM / CMS + brand documents
• Original pack shots + historical campaign creatives
• Orders / POS / returns + product costs + inventory
• Store / ecommerce / ad platforms + experiment data
• Typed SQL over governed BigQuery views
• Product revenue, margin and sales trends
• Store, market, channel and cohort comparisons
• Metric definition + window + freshness + query lineage
• Marketer review + real campaign outcome capture
• Recommendations informed by stock and economics
• Evaluated changes; no automatic efficacy approval
Product fidelity | Evidence-grounded content | Commerce intelligence | Durable execution | Governed delivery | Measured quality
BigQuery owns data, vectors and durable business records. GCS owns bytes. Orchestration coordinates work and does not grant approval.
Future-state component design • Solid arrows show primary flow; platform services apply across every layer.
